changelog:
Initial release of Budget Tracker skill.

- Track and log every agent transaction with category and notes.
- Set total budget limits and customizable alert thresholds.
- Get warnings when approaching or exceeding your budget.
- View summaries, recent history, and check if planned purchases are allowed.
- Export all records to CSV for further analysis.
- Data is stored locally in JSON; categories and security best practices included.
